title: Dotson Interview task 2

nodes.speaker: Dotson
nodes.text: Hello my young pupil. Now that "The Case of the Missing Donut" is over, Are you ready for your next test?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Hello my young pupil. Now that "The Case of the Missing Donut" is over, Are you ready for your next test?

nodes.speaker: Dotson
nodes.text: Very good. Your first test involved interviewing subjects, but your second will be harder. You will be evaluated based on the most important skill for any detective: deduction.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Very good. Your first test involved interviewing subjects, but your second will be harder. You will be evaluated based on the most important skill for any detective: deduction.

nodes.speaker: Dotson
nodes.text: Precisely. And you will face a smarter, sneakier subject than anyone you've dealt with so far.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Precisely. And you will face a smarter, sneakier subject than anyone you've dealt with so far.

nodes.speaker: Dotson
nodes.text: Correct again.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Correct again.

nodes.speaker: Dotson
nodes.text: Incorrect. Your inquisitor, your interrogator, your puzzle master will be... me.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Incorrect. Your inquisitor, your interrogator, your puzzle master will be... me.

nodes.speaker: Dotson
nodes.text: Deduction is not about empathy and social cues like interviewing. Deduction is about pure hard logic. Do you have a logical brain?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Deduction is not about empathy and social cues like interviewing. Deduction is about pure hard logic. Do you have a logical brain?

nodes.speaker: Dotson
nodes.text: Very good. Then you know "logic" is a verb and not a noun. That means you can get better at it through practice.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Very good. Then you know "logic" is a verb and not a noun. That means you can get better at it through practice.

nodes.speaker: Dotson
nodes.text: Your mind is a muscle, young apprentice! Let us get to work in the gym of intellect.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Your mind is a muscle, young apprentice! Let us get to work in the gym of intellect.

nodes.speaker: Dotson
nodes.text: Esteem. Satisfaction. The privilege of working with me.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Esteem. Satisfaction. The privilege of working with me.

nodes.speaker: Dotson
nodes.text: This is not the answer that fits best... but I can see your reasoning and I like it.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: This is not the answer that fits best... but I can see your reasoning and I like it.

nodes.speaker: Dotson
nodes.text: As she walks into a bar, a woman asks for a large glass of water. Reaching under the counter, the bartender grabs a gun and screams and shouts as he points it at her. She says "thank you", and walks out. Why?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: As she walks into a bar, a woman asks for a large glass of water. Reaching under the counter, the bartender grabs a gun and screams and shouts as he points it at her. She says "thank you", and walks out. Why?

nodes.speaker: Dotson
nodes.text: Impeccable logic. Very insightful. You're impressing me. This is my impressed emoticon.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Impeccable logic. Very insightful. You're impressing me. This is my impressed emoticon.

nodes.speaker: Dotson
nodes.text: I like how you have approached this puzzle, but this is not the finest answer you could offer. I expect perfection, or at least a superior performance.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I like how you have approached this puzzle, but this is not the finest answer you could offer. I expect perfection, or at least a superior performance.

nodes.speaker: Dotson
nodes.text: These are not riddles. They are deductive logic exercises which evaluate your deduction abilities.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: These are not riddles. They are deductive logic exercises which evaluate your deduction abilities.

nodes.speaker: Dotson
nodes.text: And yes, one more. This is the most challenging one yet. Prepare your mental faculties.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: And yes, one more. This is the most challenging one yet. Prepare your mental faculties.

nodes.speaker: Dotson
nodes.text: An insidious beast, he is like an eldritch monster at the bottom of the ocean whose tentacles extend out from the underworld and control all crime in the city. You already know him. Who is he?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: An insidious beast, he is like an eldritch monster at the bottom of the ocean whose tentacles extend out from the underworld and control all crime in the city. You already know him. Who is he?

nodes.speaker: Dotson
nodes.text: Zaffer is not a man. And you think the street artist is a crime lord? Interesting.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Zaffer is not a man. And you think the street artist is a crime lord? Interesting.

nodes.speaker: Dotson
nodes.text: Worry not! Logic is a verb and not a noun. You can learn.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Worry not! Logic is a verb and not a noun. You can learn.

nodes.speaker: Dotson
nodes.text: *Sigh* Well, I do believe good work should be monetarily rewarded now you have reached a sufficient rank. So let's say... a thousand Lims. IF you qualify.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: *Sigh* Well, I do believe good work should be monetarily rewarded now you have reached a sufficient rank. So let's say... a thousand Lims. IF you qualify.

nodes.speaker: Dotson
nodes.text: Alright, let us begin. A woman jumps out of a window of her thirty story building and survives. How is this possible?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Alright, let us begin. A woman jumps out of a window of her thirty story building and survives. How is this possible?

nodes.speaker: Dotson
nodes.text: Impressive. Let's continue.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Impressive. Let's continue.

nodes.speaker: Dotson
nodes.text: Your former mentor? I admit, his spirit lingers in the city - but a crime boss? Interesting.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Your former mentor? I admit, his spirit lingers in the city - but a crime boss? Interesting.

nodes.speaker: Dotson
nodes.text: The individual with the rats? I see no evidence pointing in that direction, but your choice is interesting nonetheless.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: The individual with the rats? I see no evidence pointing in that direction, but your choice is interesting nonetheless.

nodes.speaker: Dotson
nodes.text: Indeed.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Indeed.

nodes.speaker: Dotson
nodes.text: Me? I trust you are making a joke? Or perhaps a wry observation about the very nature of crime? Nonetheless, I do not understand your logic.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Me? I trust you are making a joke? Or perhaps a wry observation about the very nature of crime? Nonetheless, I do not understand your logic.

nodes.speaker: Dotson
nodes.text: A strange choice. I would not have considered the salty robot, but I trust you have your reasons for choosing him.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: A strange choice. I would not have considered the salty robot, but I trust you have your reasons for choosing him.

nodes.speaker: Dotson
nodes.text: I have been training you up for this moment. I will now tally your scores and evaluate if you have met the criteria for your final test.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I have been training you up for this moment. I will now tally your scores and evaluate if you have met the criteria for your final test.

nodes.speaker: Dotson
nodes.text: Tallying... Tallying.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Tallying... Tallying.

nodes.speaker: Dotson
nodes.text: Tallying... Tallying... Tallying- No! It will not take long.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Tallying... Tallying... Tallying- No! It will not take long.

nodes.speaker: Dotson
nodes.text: You have... succeeded! I knew you could do it young detective. Congratulations!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You have... succeeded! I knew you could do it young detective. Congratulations!

nodes.speaker: Dotson
nodes.text: You have... not quite made the grade. But worry not my friend! Not everyone is cut out for detective work. You performed... reasonably.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You have... not quite made the grade. But worry not my friend! Not everyone is cut out for detective work. You performed... reasonably.

nodes.speaker: Dotson
nodes.text: I served under the greatest detective Nivalis had ever seen, and he taught me everything I know. I just hope I can mentor you as well as he did me.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I served under the greatest detective Nivalis had ever seen, and he taught me everything I know. I just hope I can mentor you as well as he did me.

nodes.speaker: Dotson
nodes.text: I have credited your detective stipend to your account. Please spend these funds sensibly.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I have credited your detective stipend to your account. Please spend these funds sensibly.

nodes.speaker: Dotson
nodes.text: You must confront the crime boss I alluded to in your last test. I sent you to meet him for a reason... Razlo!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You must confront the crime boss I alluded to in your last test. I sent you to meet him for a reason... Razlo!

nodes.speaker: Dotson
nodes.text: What IS NOT dangerous in this city? But yes, I have made provisions for your safety. Confront Razlo, and begin your detecting career.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What IS NOT dangerous in this city? But yes, I have made provisions for your safety. Confront Razlo, and begin your detecting career.

nodes.speaker: Dotson
nodes.text: And we remain good friends. Best buds. Pals to the end. Now, I must get back to work. Farewell citizen!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: And we remain good friends. Best buds. Pals to the end. Now, I must get back to work. Farewell citizen!

nodes.speaker: Dotson
nodes.text: A criminal mastermind resides in Nivalis, hiding in plain sight.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: A criminal mastermind resides in Nivalis, hiding in plain sight.

nodes.speaker: Dotson
nodes.text: He seems like a normal man, but in reality he is the most dangerous mastermind who has ever lived.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: He seems like a normal man, but in reality he is the most dangerous mastermind who has ever lived.

nodes.speaker: Dotson
nodes.text: You should not give up in other endeavors! But in these particular endeavors... yes, you should probably give up.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You should not give up in other endeavors! But in these particular endeavors... yes, you should probably give up.

nodes.speaker: Dotson
nodes.text: He is more than a donut thief. He is an evil genius. Confront him, and confirm our suspicions.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: He is more than a donut thief. He is an evil genius. Confront him, and confirm our suspicions.

nodes.speaker: Dotson
nodes.text: This is your final test, and your first case. Good luck.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: This is your final test, and your first case. Good luck.
